portal_description:
The s390utils packages contain a set of user-space utilities that should be used together with the zSeries (s390) Linux kernel and device drivers.

Bug Fix(es):

* RHEL9.0 - SE-tooling: New IBM host-key subject locality (s390utils/s390-tools) (JIRA:RHEL-30394)

* RHEL9.0 - dbginfo.sh: missing data of new ROCE cards (s390utils/s390-tools) [rhel-9.4.z] (JIRA:RHEL-31490)
